classificationRules.appearance-only: Potentially reversible as its own reviewed presentation unit. Check later consumers and companion fixes; never infer blanket permission from this classification.
classificationRules.appearance-layout: Changes geometry, container ownership, wrapping or scroll behavior. Review dependent callers and subsequent lifecycle repairs; not a paint-only reversal.
classificationRules.functional-workflow: Owns routing, API, dispatch or workflow behavior. Excluded from appearance-only reversal.
classificationRules.correctness-repair: Preserves or restores behavior, compilation, identity or lifecycle after a presentation change. Retain with its dependent unit; never reverse independently to express an appearance preference.
classificationRules.verification-only: No production appearance change. Retain or adapt the checks to the reviewed production state.
classificationRules.localization: Localized functional copy and documentation. Preserve independently of visual preference.

notInReviewedCandidate.reason: Not an ancestor of the reviewed candidate. Reported title/history paint, project strips, nested books and tab dialogs are not claimed present here.
